what: Around a tilted pinned thumbnail card (12px outside, a rounded-rectangle path with corner radius 30) the text ‹Showreel • 2025 •› circles once in 12 seconds, each letter starting .12s later — letters stand upside down (180°) facing the outside of the path, wrapping around the card (CSS offset-path, no curves)

options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text to run around the edge (hidden) — text option if none
options.each: Delay between letters (sec), default .12 — fills in letters by length ÷ delay
options.gap: Distance to float outside the card (px), default 12

use: Showreel • 2025
note: The original spins the letters backward (-100% → 0) — same direction here. Letter size and color follow the element’s font and color
